comment: The Jotter pattern, part (a) — declared AS DATA (Marathon R7 lane BB; Jotter GPL-3.0-or-later, pattern only, no code copied): the stated shape of a source_record frontmatter block, checked by scripts/wiki_jotter.py validate. The record travels WITH the page; there is no separate bibliographic database.
rule: title is required; at least one locator (url, doi or raw) is required; unknown fields are findings.
